summary: The exact candidate fully implements the requested unified JIT cache root and fixes the independently reported DeepGEMM import-order defect. Its regression suite passed, independent precedence and source-import checks passed, and a real ROCm torch.compile run wrote numerically correct Inductor/Triton artifacts beneath the configured root.

tests.command: base 358c163250ad3b1f62939b01ce1314a0a31a0365: clean import plus supported-platform synthetic deep_gemm first-import hook
tests.what_was_measured: Reproduced the original incompleteness: SGLANG_JIT_CACHE_ROOT was absent, and the first deep_gemm import observed DG_JIT_CACHE_DIR as unset. See reports/j-652ca01d1698/evidence/base_reproduction.txt.
Nine candidate regressions passed at exact commit 2840b82be46c4e30d138aff60627168e7a4d6987, including executable DeepGEMM first-import ordering.

tests.command: clean-process independent cache-root and override-precedence subprocesses at candidate commit
tests.what_was_measured: Confirmed repository source imports, root-derived triton/inductor/deep_gemm paths, SGLANG_DG_CACHE_DIR precedence, and native DG_JIT_CACHE_DIR backward compatibility.
On one MI355X, compiled relu(matmul) matched eager output with max absolute error 0.0 and generated Inductor plus Triton AMDGPU/HSACO artifacts solely beneath the configured root.
The candidate diff contains no whitespace errors.

gpu_evidence: AMD Instinct MI355X with torch 2.11.0+rocm7.2 / HIP 7.2.26015; real Inductor and Triton compilation produced .amdgcn and .hsaco artifacts under the candidate's configured root, with max absolute numerical error 0.0 against eager PyTorch.
remaining_limitations: No native source changed, so a native rebuild was not applicable.

The prepared GPU is ROCm. Actual DeepGEMM cache-file creation on its CUDA/MUSA supported paths could not be executed; first-import ordering and precedence were verified behaviorally with a synthetic supported-platform import hook.
CUDA driver and FlashInfer CUDA cache writes were not executable on ROCm; their source mappings and import-time setup were inspected but not runtime-qualified on CUDA.
No serving/model fixture was run because the issue concerns process-level compiler-cache configuration; the real GPU compiler exercise directly covered the available affected Inductor/Triton paths.
